A3_mixed_feedback_today.question: under current code, a card converts on units X and Y through both gates and is refused on unit Z by Support or by delayed. What does the system do to the card?
A3_mixed_feedback_today.verdict: NOTHING, in every branch that the production line can actually reach

branches.branch: refused at Support (the supplied candidate probes and does not clear the material line, or the verifier rejects it, or the Support budget never reaches it)
branches.what_is_written_at_all: a proposals row with outcome and gain (run_e2_s1_curriculum_four_arms.py:1302-1320) and, if it probed, an Episode graded EPISODE_ONLY
branches.consequence: the card keeps the same Scope and is re-supplied at every later Scope-matching unit, spending one pool slot and one probe each time

branches.branch: delayed reads CONFLICT (aggregate positive, per-series harm)
branches.card_effect: none for a supply card. The restriction PATCH requires delayed_event.stage == existing_skill_revalidated (runner.py:949-954), which only the local-skill reuse path emits (e1.py:1305 -> _existing_local_skill -> _is_local_skill_id at e1.py:689-690/133). A source supply card id is not a fast_winner_* id, so the reuse path never fires for it
branches.consequence: the RESTRICTED verdict lands on the Episode and, at most, on the Target-local derivative -- never on the source card

branches.card_effect_in_the_production_line: unreachable -- open_delayed is not called from the Task-Episode harness (see A2)

branches.card_effect: none. The win mints a NEW Target-local fast_winner_* skill through handle_fast_winner (evaluation/functional/task_episode_harness/e1.py:1362-1382) and stamps it to the unit (run_e2_s1_curriculum_four_arms.py:1283-1284). The source card's own evidence block is frozen at compile time (source_skill.py:554-569) and is never appended to
branches.consequence: positive feedback does not accumulate on the card either -- the evidence ledger is write-once at compile, so 'Skill as an updatable hypothesis' has no write path in any direction

A3_mixed_feedback_today.one_line_answer: today a card is compiled once and then frozen: positives do not accumulate on it, a Support refusal is invisible to it, and a delayed refusal reaches it only through a path that the production harness does not call

A4_revocation_bluntness.question: does one refusal somewhere destroy a card that is positive elsewhere, and under exactly what condition and scope?
A4_revocation_bluntness.verdict: the two revocation mechanisms are maximally blunt BY DESIGN, and are simultaneously UNREACHABLE for supply cards in the production line -- so the real present-day risk is the opposite one: no response at all

bluntness_analysis.precise_condition: one unit's delayed window grades the reused local skill's Episode CONFLICT or worse (RESTRICTED), on that single unit (runner.py:947-954; grading at online_loop.py:244-249)
bluntness_analysis.scope_of_effect: GLOBAL -- retrieval.py:269-270 skips the entry before applicability is evaluated, in both fast and slow roles; e1.py:549-557 enforces the same on a second channel
bluntness_analysis.bluntness: one unit's refusal removes the card everywhere, including in every context where it had already converted. There is no per-domain or per-Scope variant of this guard anywhere in the codebase
bluntness_analysis.mitigations_present: the entry and its restriction_reason stay in the snapshot (auditable), and a re-probe can lift the restriction forward (e1.py:1139-1183)
bluntness_analysis.who_it_can_actually_hit_today: arm-local fast_winner_* skills only (the _is_local_skill_id filter). Those are already domain-stamped to one unit, so in practice the blunt global guard currently acts on an entry whose reach was one unit anyway -- the bluntness is latent, not yet expressed

bluntness_analysis.precise_condition: the winner was a cand_skill_* candidate and that round's delayed_utility < -0.005 (online_loop.py:814-817)
bluntness_analysis.scope_of_effect: GLOBAL AND DESTRUCTIVE -- the skill JSON is unlinked from the fork (online_loop.py:723) and the recompiled snapshot becomes active
bluntness_analysis.bluntness: strictly worse than the guard: a single delayed reading below the material line on one unit deletes the card from the active tree; prior snapshots keep the bytes, so history survives, but the card's Scope, evidence block and any accumulated ledger are gone from the live view
bluntness_analysis.who_it_can_actually_hit_today: nobody in this harness -- not called (see A2)

A4_revocation_bluntness.the_finding_that_matters: the ledger entry of 2026-08-28 02:3x records the single-Episode supply card's safety net as 'Target counter-evidence triggers restricted_by_target_feedback and pulls it out of retrieval (retrieval.py:143/269, in production)'. The READER is in production. The WRITER's trigger is gated on the local-skill reuse path and therefore cannot fire for a supply card, and the alternative writer is not called by this harness. The net for the n=1 card is, as wired, unarmed. This does not change the L1 verdict logic, because a card that is never revoked is not a card that is wrongly revoked -- but it does mean the low price is currently backed by the verifier plus the Support/delayed double gate plus the harm veto, and not by any after-the-fact withdrawal.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: the supply card's compiled Scope carries a duplicated task_kind leaf
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: evaluation/functional/task_episode_harness/agentic/source_skill.py:467-474 seeds the leaf list with task_kind and then iterates pattern_intersection, which already contains task_kind; the L1 compiled card therefore has 18 leaves over 17 distinct features (artifacts/functional/e2/l1_ladder_v2_replay_r1.json -> t1.card.observable_applicability)
cross_cutting_findings.impact: cosmetic for matching (the duplicate is a tautology) but it inflates the leaf count in every scope_leaves readout and it double-counts in the applicability score used for capability ranking (retrieval.py:278-284, :290-299)

cross_cutting_findings.finding: four pattern leaves are silently dropped from the Scope because the edit schema cannot carry them
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: source_skill.py:459-475 with legal_features from :434-456; the L1 card records pattern_leaves_dropped_as_uncontracted_for_edit_schema = [level_only_post_shift_support_sufficient, level_region_end_fraction, level_region_fraction, outlier_region_end_fraction]
cross_cutting_findings.impact: the effective Scope is WIDER than the recorded scope_v1 by exactly those four axes; a Scope-narrowing rule that compiles exclusions from the same schema will inherit the same blind spot, and it must say so rather than claim the intersection is exact

cross_cutting_findings.finding: the intersection Scope at n=1 is too narrow to have anything to revise
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: artifacts/functional/e2/l1_ladder_v2_replay_r1.json -> t1.scope_table: 1 of the 5 tail units machine-matches, against a pre-registered 4 of 5. Recomputed leaf-by-leaf against the v4 frozen pattern views: GunPoint misses on period_change_score alone (high vs zero), PowerCons on period_change_score alone (high vs very_low), Herring on 2 of 17, BirdChicken on 3 of 17
cross_cutting_findings.impact: a single incidental leaf carried from one Episode decides two of the three non-matches. Before a revision loop can be measured, the Scope has to start wide enough to be worth narrowing

open_questions_for_sol.question: no fault cause means 'this Scope reached too far'. Do we reuse RETRIEVAL_MISS for a monotone narrowing PATCH (semantically wrong, zero contract change) or add a SCOPE_OVERREACH cause (semantically right, touches fault_routes.json and the router)?

SkillEntry.revision is a static authoring field that nothing increments. Does a revision bump the counter (touching every mint site and any equality/sha assumption downstream), or do we version by content sha and leave revision alone?

restricted_by_target_feedback is whole-card and global by construction. Is the per-domain variant a new guard key (retrieval reads a restriction with a Scope), or is it exactly the Scope-exclusion PATCH under a different name? If the latter, the negative branch and the conflict branch of the revision rules collapse into one mechanism.

the supply card's revocation net is not armed: the writer's trigger is gated on the local-skill reuse path and the destructive path is not called by this harness. Do we arm it (extend the trigger to supply cards), leave it unarmed and say so in the ladder's safety argument, or supersede it with the versioned narrowing mechanism?

an Episode's ledger slot is overwritten when delayed lands, so the Support-only version is not retained. Does the evidence ledger for a revisable Skill need an append-only Episode trail, and if so does that live in the store or in the artifact?

the Episode record has no source_skill_id, so a card-supplied program and an agent-self-proposed identical program are the same record. v4 produced exactly that collision. Is adding the field a pure instrument change (no governance content) that SA-1 may land, or does it need the same review as a mechanism?

four pattern axes are dropped from the Scope because the edit schema cannot carry them, so the effective Scope is wider than the recorded one. Does a narrowing rule get to exclude on a dropped axis (it cannot -- the manifest would fail shape validation), and if not, must the design declare those axes permanently unreachable for both widening and narrowing?

an exclusion built from a unit whose leaves are absent from a later unit's features makes the whole AST abstain, so the card is withheld from units it was never meant to be excluded from. Is silent over-withholding acceptable, or must the exclusion be restricted to leaves present in the source Episode AND guaranteed present by the feature contract?

the intersection Scope at n=1 reaches 1 of 5 units, and a single incidental leaf (period_change_score) causes two of the three near-misses. A revision loop needs a Scope worth narrowing. Widening the initial Scope is a ladder repricing question, not a revision question -- does sol want it opened, and if so on which axis-selection rule?

in this harness the supply card reaches the agent through a mechanical candidate injection at the methods layer (fast_agent.py:1014) and simultaneously through its prose body being rendered into the harness view. The ladder priced the mechanical channel only. Does the prose channel need separate pricing before a card is allowed to be revised (a revised card's prose changes what the agent reads), or does the Stage-3 deferral stand?

the duplicated task_kind leaf double-counts in the applicability score that orders capability retrieval. Trivial to fix, but it changes compiled card bytes and therefore every frozen card sha. Fix now, or record and freeze?

monotone narrowing is declared Slow-autonomous in the design. Narrowing is monotone in Scope but it is NOT monotone in outcome -- withholding a card can lose a gain the card would have earned. Does 'monotone narrowing is autonomous' need a bounded-loss clause, or is the asymmetry accepted deliberately (a lost gain is recoverable, a harm is not)?
